author: ronaldschmidt
name: Recur 16x1024 x2-share KV1 fp16-tok+mlpout+q (local proxy)
blurb: Shared-block recurrent transformer with MQA-style KV sharing and selective fp16 export for the tied embedding, MLP output projection, and Q projection. This is the strongest legal local result produced in the current search; metric is from a 262,144-token prefix of the official validation split, not a full record-eligible run.
